question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a purple present, Bob has a teal present, Claire has a green present, Dave has a silver present, Eve has a yellow present, Fred has a red present, and Gertrude has a gold present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Gertrude and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Dave swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) purple present
(B) teal present
(C) green present
(D) silver present
(E) yellow present
(F) red present
(G) gold present
solution:
Each row lists the present colors held by Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude, in that order.
Initial: purple | teal | green | silver | yellow | red | gold
1. Gertrude and Dave swap: purple | teal | green | gold | yellow | red | silver
2. Dave and Gertrude swap: purple | teal | green | silver | yellow | red | gold
3. Eve and Bob swap: purple | yellow | green | silver | teal | red | gold
4. Fred and Claire swap: purple | yellow | red | silver | teal | green | gold
5. Dave and Eve swap: purple | yellow | red | teal | silver | green | gold
6. Dave and Eve swap: purple | yellow | red | silver | teal | green | gold
7. Fred and Dave swap: purple | yellow | red | green | teal | silver | gold
Bob has the yellow present, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
